result.description: Application monitoring platform for error tracking, performance monitoring and issue triage.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization code grant (with device flow and PKCE) for third-party apps. Bearer auth tokens come from internal integrations (org-scoped) or User settings > Personal Tokens, with scopes. Legacy API keys are still described, but deprecated.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up and create internal integrations, personal tokens or OAuth apps. The docs pages checked do not say API access is plan-restricted. Sentry is known to have a free Developer plan, but I did not check the pricing page, so that part is not verified here.
result.api_notes: The web API (v0) covers organizations, teams, projects, issues, events, releases and more, about 25 resource areas. Public endpoints are generally stable, but beta endpoints may change. Access tokens expire after 30 days. Rate limits apply.
